events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's title hopes are hit by an unexpected blow when they lose 1–0 at home to 사우샘프턴.
Norwegian striker Steffen Iversen scores a hat-trick as 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat relegation-threatened 선덜랜드 4–0 at Roker Park .

미들즈브러's survival hopes are given a major boost when they beat 더비 카운티 6–1 at the Riverside Stadium, with Fabrizio Ravanelli scoring a hat-trick. 노팅엄 포리스트's survival hopes are dented when they lose 3–0 at home 셰필드 웬즈데이, whose hopes of a UEFA Cup place are kept very much alive by the result.

미들즈브러 move closer to a first-ever FA Cup final by winning 2–0 at 더비 카운티 in the quarter-final. 맨체스터 유나이티드's four-month unbeaten run in the lead ends in a surprise 2–1 defeat against 선덜랜드 at Roker Park.

In a rare occurrence of an FA Cup quarter-final being contested between two third-tier clubs, 체스터필드 run out 1–0 winners over 렉섬 at Saltergate. On the same day, 윔블던 move closer to FA Cup glory by winning 2–0 at 셰필드 웬즈데이, while the end is in sight for 첼시's 26-year trophy drought as they crush 포츠머스 4–1 at Fratton Park .
Premier League strugglers 노팅엄 포리스트 sign Dutch striker Pierre Van Hooijdonk from 셀틱 for a club record £4.5million. In the title race, 리버풀 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 4–3 at Anfield.
Recently signed striker Paul Kitson scores twice as 웨스트햄 유나이티드 boost their survival bid with a 3–2 home win over 첼시.
Kevin Gallacher scores a hat-trick in 블랙번 로버스's 3–1 home league win over 윔블던. 미들즈브러 continue to push for survival with a 3–1 away win over 레스터 시티.
선덜랜드's survival hopes are knocked by a 6–2 defeat at 첼시.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are knocked out of the UEFA Cup at the quarter-final stage by AS AS 모나코 FC , who join 인테르 , CD 테네리페 and FC 샬케 in the semi-finals. In the one English top-flight match, Stan Lazaridis scores a last-minute equalizer for 웨스트햄 유나이티드, cancelling out Mick Harford 's first goal of the season.
미들즈브러 continue their fightback with a 2–1 home win over 블랙번 로버스.

John Hartson is on the scoresheet twice for 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in a relegation crunch win at 코번트리 시티. 미들즈브러 make it four league wins in a row as a Juninho goal gives them a 1–0 home win over 첼시. Another relegation crunch game sees 선덜랜드 and 노팅엄 포리스트 battle out a 1–1 draw at Roker Park.
미들즈브러 fail in an appeal to restore 3 points that were docked in early January as penalty for failing to fulfil a fixture against 블랙번 로버스 .
웨스트햄 유나이티드 buy Northern Ireland midfielder Steve Lomas from 맨체스터 시티 for £1.6million.

맨체스터 유나이티드 continue to lead the Premier League for third month-end running, with 리버풀 still their nearest challengers. 사우샘프턴 are now bottom of the Premier League, while 노팅엄 포리스트 have slipped back into the drop zone along with 코번트리 시티. 블랙번 로버스 continue to move closer to what once seemed like an almost impossible survival as they stand 12th with a six-point advantage over the bottom three and a game in hand. 볼턴 원더러스 are now just one point away from promotion at the top of Division One, with 반즐리 now in second place and well on course for top-division football for the first time in their 101-year history. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 셰필드 유나이티드, 크리스털 팰리스 and surprise promotion contenders 포트 베일 occupy the playoff zone.
